text_block_list.text:
After Seiun Sky and I finish training, we
head to
the shopping district together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are a lot of people here
today.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Lookie here, it's a raffle!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, didn't we get something from
the
cashier when we bought our snacks?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a raffle ticket! What a weird

coincidence! ☆ Guess we gotta try our
luck!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! You saw right through me?!
choice_data_list: If only she'd just be honest and say she wants to do it...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's too bad. I wanted to make you
feel
thrilled, as if fortune was smiling
down on you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh well. I, of course, wanna win that hot
spring
vacation!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So the rest is up to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Keeping your Umamusume motivated is an important part of your job! With a hot spring vacation as bait, I'll have to do my finest in training! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that sound appealing? Now go
win that
prize!

With Sky looking over my shoulder, and
my heart
pounding rapidly, I pull the
raffle lever!

A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You did it! You got the hot spring
vacation!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You master among trainers! You're
bursting with
trainer magic!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, when should we go? Tomorrow?
The day
after?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What if we go right after training one
day? It
would feel so nice to wash off all
that sweat!

But then I realize where the conversation
is going
and snap out of it. There's no
way we can take a
carefree trip to a hot
spring right at the start of
her senior
year!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: Let's save that for when we reach a good stopping point!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Damn, you caught on. And I was so
close!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're such a buzzkill, wasting an
opportunity to
warm me up for the year!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you I'll work harder if you
give me a
reward?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Please! If you take me to the hot spring,
I really
will start training seriously! I
promise!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmph, why am I not surprised?
choice_data_list: If you work hard, you can go to the hot springs, so give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Then promise me that you'll take me to
the hot
spring once I've worked hard
enough.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You'll do all the necessary preparations
before
the trip? And you'll treat me like
a princess so I
won't have to lift a finger?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You said sure! ☆ Now I'm sooo excited
to put in
the effort for that hot spring. ♪

That's how I end up holding onto the
ticket for
the hot spring vacation.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, first prize! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? This is
amazing
enough!
choice_data_list: Sorry it's not an actual hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, this hamburger steak looks
tasty! ♪ I'm
gonna chow down on this
baby tonight!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm actually a very impressive
Umamusume,
I'll have you know.
choice_data_list: Can you finish all that by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, not that I eat as much as Spe or
Grass...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I got it. If you're worried, why don't you
join me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You're the one who won it
after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I get the first bite of the carrot! ♪

Afterward, we return to the academy
and split the
hamburger steak, and
without hesitation, Sky cuts
me the
larger portion.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Just look at aaall these
carrots...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What am I even supposed to do with
'em?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I guess I could hand some out to anyone
who
wants them on campus.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha! I just came up with something
even
better. ☆
Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right now, everyone form a line! How
about we
hear from you first?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I found the perfect spot to hang
up a
hammock in the next town over!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that sounds perfect for a nap. For
this
valuable intelligence, I give you...
five carrots!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thanks. ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Me next, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. Still got lots of carrots to
go
around, no reason to rush.

Looks like Seiun Sky found a new way to
gather
information.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wowie, one carrot.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What are you apologizing for? I'm crazy
about
carrots. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
My motivation level remains stable! But
if you
wanna make this even better...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How about we get a piping hot potato
croquette
while we're here? ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yay! ☆ You're so generous, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Youch, that's hot... Blow, blow...

I watch Sky as she struggles to eat the
steaming
croquettes with her carrot.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha! No need to apologize. It's a game
of luck,
so nothing we can do about it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But still...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't be surprised if my motivation
decreases. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. Maintaining my mood is

luck-based as well.

The next day, sure enough, Seiun Sky
shows up
late to practice...
